title: User manual
subtitle: How to use SIS Manager, page by page, for your role

concept.title: What this app is for
body: SIS Manager is the SIS Music Bar app for two jobs — liquor deposits and table bookings — for every branch, in one place.

Staff use it on a phone or a computer. Customers use the branch's LINE account: they see their stored bottles, ask to withdraw or deposit, and book tables themselves, and that work lands in this app for staff to finish.

When something moves forward — the bar confirms a bottle, a withdrawal is done, a bottle is about to expire, the shop confirms a booking — customers who linked LINE get a message automatically, in the language they chose.
Everyone sees the menus of their own role, and only the branches they have access to. The owner sees every branch.

deposit.title: How a deposit moves
steps: A customer brings a bottle: staff press **New deposit**, fill in the details and take a photo. If the customer sent a deposit request on LINE first, staff press **Receive bottles** instead.
The deposit shows **To confirm**. The bar enters the % left in every bottle, takes a photo and presses **Confirm and shelve**.
The deposit is now **In store**; customers who linked LINE get a confirmation. Staff print the receipt for the customer and a label for the bottle.
When the customer wants a drink or to take it home, they request it on LINE or staff create a withdrawal request, then the bar presses **Complete withdrawal**.
If nobody collects it before the **Collect by** date and time, it becomes **Expired** and waits for bar or owner to press **Dispose**.

booking.title: How a booking moves
steps: A customer books on LINE, or staff press **New booking** for them.
LINE bookings appear under **Waiting for confirmation**; bar or owner press **Confirm + assign** (with automatic confirmation turned on, this happens right away).
The customer gets a confirmation on LINE and sees a QR on their booking page.
On the night, staff scan the QR or type the booking number and press **Customer arrived**.
If the guest doesn't come within the time the shop set, the booking turns **No-show**.

roles.title: Roles in the shop
roles.intro: There are three roles, and each sees a different set of menus. Just read the parts for your role.

staff.name: staff
staff.summary: Front-of-house staff: take deposits and bookings, welcome guests
can: Take in deposits — a bottle photo is required every time
Receive bottles for deposit requests customers sent on LINE
Print receipts and bottle labels, including reprints
Book tables for customers and check them in when they arrive
Scan booking QRs and bottle-label QRs
Work only in the branches the owner gave them

bar.name: bar
bar.summary: Runs the bar and the shelves: everything staff can do, plus the approvals
can: Confirm bottles with a % for each bottle and a photo
Extend, make or remove VIP, and set the expiry date when taking a deposit
Confirm, reject or cancel bookings, assign and change tables

owner.name: owner
owner.summary: The owner: sees every branch, the overview and reports, and every setting
can: Everything bar can do, in every branch
See the all-branch overview and reports, export Excel and PDF
Set up branches, booking rules, the floor plan, the liquor list, LINE and the printer
Create staff accounts, set roles and branches, and set new passwords

login.title: Log in
login.intro: The first screen when you open the app. Use the username and password the owner created for you.
onPage: The shop logo and the SIS Manager name
The **Username or e-mail** field
The **Password** field
The **Log in** button

signIn.title: How to log in
steps: Open the app in the browser, or from the icon on your home screen
Type the **Username or e-mail** the owner gave you
Type your **Password** and press **Log in**
staff and bar land on **Tonight**; the owner lands on **All branches**

forgot.title: What to do if you forget your password
steps: Tell the owner
The owner presses **Set new password** for you on **Users & branches**
Log in with the new password, then change it to your own on **My account**

signOut.title: How to log out
steps: On a phone, press **More** in the bottom bar, then **Log out**
On a computer, press **Log out** at the bottom of the left menu

important: If a message says the account is disabled, contact the owner
After several wrong passwords in a row, wait a moment before trying again
tips: Usernames work in upper or lower case
On a shared device, log out at the end of every shift

appLayout.title: App layout and menus
appLayout.intro: The menus and buttons on every page: move between pages, switch branch, read notifications, check the printer and change the colour mode.
onPage: Phone: a 5-slot bottom bar — **Tonight** (the owner sees **Overview**) · **Deposits** · the dark round scan button in the middle · **Bookings** · **More**
Computer: a left menu with **Daily** and **Account** (the owner also has **Reports** and **Settings**)
Top right of every page: the printer icon, the **Notifications** bell and the moon or sun button
The selected branch name, and a branch picker for people who work in several branches
Lists are cards on a phone and tables on a computer

navigate.title: How to move around on a phone
steps: Press a slot in the bottom bar to open **Tonight**, **Deposits** or **Bookings**
Press the dark round button in the middle to open **Scan QR**
Press **More** — a sheet slides up from the bottom with **My account** and **Log out**
The owner also sees **Overview & reports** and **Branch settings** in this sheet

switchBranch.title: How to switch branch
steps: On a phone, press **More**, then the branch name at the top of the sheet
On a computer, press the branch name under the logo in the left menu
Pick a branch — every page switches to that branch's data

bell.title: How to read notifications
steps: Press the bell at the top right; the red number is how many are unread
Press an item to open its page; it then counts as read
Press **Mark all read** to clear the number
Every role is told about withdrawal requests and LINE deposit requests; bar and owner are also told about bottles to confirm and new bookings waiting for confirmation

printer.title: How to check the printer
steps: Look at the dot on the printer icon at the top right
Green = **Online**, ready to print · red = **Offline** · grey = **Not set up**
The owner can press the icon to jump to the printer part of **Branch details**

theme.title: How to switch light or dark mode
steps: Press the moon button at the top right for dark mode
Press the sun button to go back to light mode

homeScreen.title: How to add the app to your home screen
steps: Open the app in your phone's browser
iPhone: in Safari, press Share, then Add to Home Screen
Android: in Chrome, press the ⋮ menu, then Install app or Add to Home screen
From then on, open it from the SIS icon on your home screen

important: All work happens in the branch you have selected — check the branch name before taking a deposit or a booking
tips: Pages update by themselves when new work arrives — no need to refresh
The branch picker only appears for people with more than one branch
On a phone, sheets and windows slide up from the bottom; tap the dark area outside to close them

myAccount.title: My account
myAccount.intro: See your account, change language and theme, turn on notifications for this device and change your password. Open it from **More** on a phone or the left menu on a computer.
onPage: **Profile**: display name, username, role and branch access
**Language**: **ไทย** or **English**
**Theme**: **Light mode** or **Dark mode**
**Notifications on this device**
**Change password**

language.title: How to change the language
steps: Under **Language**, press **ไทย** or **English**
Every page switches at once, and your account remembers it

push.title: How to turn on notifications for this device
steps: Under **Notifications on this device**, press **Turn on**
Allow notifications when the browser asks
This device now alerts you about bottles to confirm, withdrawal requests and new bookings, even when the app is closed
To stop them, press **Turn off**

password.title: How to change your password
steps: Under **Change password**, fill in **Current password**
Fill in a **New password** of at least 8 characters, then type it again in **Confirm new password**
Press **Save** — you'll see **Password changed**

important: Notifications are turned on per device — if you use several devices, turn them on on each one
On an iPhone, add the app to the Home Screen first; then notifications can be turned on
tips: If it says notifications are blocked for this site, allow them in the browser settings and press again
Language is remembered by your account; theme is remembered by each device

tonight.title: Tonight
tonight.intro: The home page for staff and bar: tonight's work at the selected branch — bookings, jobs waiting and bottles about to expire.
onPage: The **Tonight** heading with the branch name, the date and opening hours
Summary numbers **Bookings tonight** · **Withdrawal requests** · **Expiring in N days**, plus **Bottles for bar to confirm** (bar only)
**Tonight's bookings** by time, with table, name, party size and an **Arrived** button
**To do**: bottles to confirm, withdrawal requests and LINE deposit requests
**Expiring soon**: bottles close to their expiry, with the date and what's left

checkIn.title: How to check a guest in from this page
steps: Look through **Tonight's bookings**
When the guest arrives, press **Arrived** at the end of their row
The row now shows a green **Arrived** badge

work.title: How to clear the to-do list
steps: Look at **To do**
Press an item to open that deposit
staff press **Receive bottles** for LINE deposit requests
bar press **Confirm bottles** or **Complete withdrawal**, depending on the job

numbers.title: How to use the summary numbers
steps: Press a number to open the list behind it
**Bookings tonight** opens **Bookings** · **Withdrawal requests** opens the **Withdrawals** tab · **Expiring in N days** opens the **In store** tab
bar press **Bottles for bar to confirm** to open the **To confirm** tab

important: This page only shows the selected branch — switch branch first if you work in several
The **Arrived** button only appears on confirmed bookings; bookings still **Awaiting confirmation** can be checked in from **Bookings** or **Scan QR**
tips: Keep this page open while the shop is open — new jobs appear without refreshing
Press **Floor plan** to see which tables are free or booked

deposits.title: Deposits
deposits.intro: Every deposit at the branch, in tabs by status and searchable — and where new deposits start.
onPage: The **New deposit** button at the top right
Tabs **In store** · **To confirm** · **Withdrawals** · **LINE requests** · **Expired · to dispose** · **Closed**, each with a count
A search box for customer name, phone or deposit code, and a **Search** button
Each row shows the deposit code, customer, liquor, what's left, the expiry date and a status badge
**Previous** and **Next** buttons at the end when there are several pages

tabs.title: How to read each tab
steps: **In store**: bottles on the shelf, including those with a withdrawal request pending
**To confirm**: received, waiting for bar to enter % and a photo
**Withdrawals**: a customer or staff member asked to withdraw; waiting for bar
**LINE requests**: the customer filled in a deposit request on LINE; waiting for staff to receive the bottle
**Expired · to dispose**: past the collection deadline, waiting to come off the shelf
**Closed**: fully withdrawn, disposed or cancelled

search.title: How to search
steps: Pick the tab first
Type the customer name, phone or deposit code in the search box
Press **Search**, then press a row to open it

dispose.title: How to dispose of expired bottles
steps: Open the **Expired · to dispose** tab
Take the bottles off the shelf first
Keep ticked only the rows you actually took off (all rows start ticked)
Press **Dispose N**
Add a **Reason** if you like, then press **Dispose**

important: Disposing can't be undone, and the customer is told on LINE right away
staff can see the **Expired · to dispose** tab, but only bar and owner can dispose
tips: An orange or red **N days left** badge means the bottle expires soon; a gold **VIP · never expires** badge means it never expires
Can't find it? Try another tab — fully withdrawn deposits are under **Closed**
Cards on a phone, a table on a computer — press any row to open its details

newDeposit.title: New deposit
newDeposit.intro: The form for a bottle a customer brings in. After you save, the bar confirms each bottle's % again before it goes on the shelf.
onPage: **Customer name** and **Phone**
**Liquor**: type or pick from the shop's liquor list
**Bottles** and **Table**
**Expires**: set by the branch's deposit term
**Bottle photo** with an **Add photo** button
**Notes** and the **Save deposit** button

create.title: How to take a deposit
steps: Go to **Deposits** and press **New deposit**
Fill in **Customer name** and **Phone**
In **Liquor**, type the name and pick it from the list that appears; if it isn't listed, just type the name
Enter **Bottles** (1–50) and **Table**
Press **Add photo** and take a photo of the bottles — you can add several
Press **Save deposit** — you'll see the deposit code and its page opens right away

expiry.title: How to set the expiry date yourself
steps: In **Expires**, pick a new date from the calendar
Fill in the rest and press **Save deposit** as usual

important: staff need at least one bottle photo before they can save
The deposit goes into the selected branch — check the branch name before saving
After saving, the deposit waits in the **To confirm** tab until the bar confirms it
tips: Photograph the label and the liquor level clearly — it helps if anything is checked later
Added photos show as numbers 1, 2, … — press ✕ on a number to remove that photo
Always add a phone number: it helps searching, and shows the guest's bottles when checking in a booking

depositDetail.title: Deposit details
depositDetail.intro: The page for one deposit: every bottle, the expiry and the history, and the buttons for what comes next. Which buttons you see depends on your role and the deposit's status.
onPage: Liquor name, deposit code, customer name and a status badge
**Bottles**: each bottle with the % left
**LINE** status (**LINE linked** or **LINE not linked**), **Deposited**, **Expires**, **Collect by** and **Received by**
**Photos** taken when received and when confirmed
Action buttons such as **Withdraw**, **Print receipt**, **Print bottle label**
**History**: everything that happened to this deposit, with the time and who did it

receive.title: How to receive bottles for a LINE deposit request
steps: Open the deposit from the **LINE requests** tab
Take the bottles from the customer and press **Receive bottles**
Correct **Bottles** to the number you actually received
Press **Add photo**, take a photo, then press **Receive bottles**
The deposit moves to the **To confirm** tab

confirm.title: How to confirm bottles
steps: Open the deposit from the **To confirm** tab and press **Confirm bottles**
Enter the % left for every bottle, e.g. **Bottle 1 remaining (%)**; a sealed bottle is 100
Under **Confirmation photo**, press the camera button and take a photo
Press **Confirm and shelve** — the deposit becomes **In store**

rejectDeposit.title: How to reject a deposit
steps: Press **Reject deposit** (shown on deposit requests and on deposits waiting to be confirmed)
Write a **Reason** the customer will understand
Press **Reject** — the deposit becomes **Cancelled**

withdraw.title: How to create a withdrawal request
steps: Press **Withdraw**
Tick the bottles under **Bottles to withdraw**
Under **Withdrawal**, choose **Drink in store** or **Take home**
Enter the **Table** and press **Create request**
The request waits in the **Withdrawals** tab for the bar

completeWithdraw.title: How to complete or reject a withdrawal
steps: Open a deposit with a request — the **Complete withdrawal** box shows the bottles, the type and the table
Bring the bottle to the customer, press **Complete withdrawal**, then **Withdraw now**
If it can't be done, press **Reject withdrawal**, add a **Reason** and press **Reject**
Customer waiting at the bar? Create the request with **Withdraw** first, then press **Complete withdrawal** straight away

extend.title: How to extend
steps: Press **Extend**
Enter the days in **Extend by (days)** and check the new expiry date under the field
Press **Extend** again to save

vip.title: How to make or remove VIP
steps: Press **Make VIP**, then **Confirm** — VIP bottles never expire
To undo, press **Remove VIP**, then **Confirm**
After removing VIP, the deposit term starts again from today

print.title: How to print the receipt and the bottle label
steps: Press **Print receipt** or **Print bottle label**
If the printer is online, press **Print**
If the printer isn't running, press **Queue it anyway** — it prints once the shop computer is on
Give the receipt to the customer and stick the label on the bottle

important: Customers who linked LINE get a message when the bar confirms, rejects a deposit, completes or rejects a withdrawal
Press **Complete withdrawal** before the **Collect by** date and time — after that the bottle can't be withdrawn
On a no-in-store-withdrawal day, **Drink in store** can't be picked — choose **Take home**
tips: When the owner turns on **Show the LINE QR on the receipt**, the receipt carries the shop's LINE QR and a 6-character code: the customer scans it, adds the shop, types the code in the chat, and sees their bottles in LINE
Print the receipt after the bar confirms — the % on it then matches the real bottles
Customer lost the receipt? Press **Print receipt** again for a new one

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.intro: See each night's bookings as a floor plan or a list, book for customers, confirm LINE bookings and check guests in.
onPage: The night picker (left/right arrows and a date) and the **New booking** button
**Waiting for confirmation**: bookings waiting for the shop from tonight on, grouped under **Tonight**, **Tomorrow** and dates
Tabs **Floor plan** and **List**
A summary of the night: tables, guests, and how many are booked out of the total
The floor plan by zone, coloured **Free**, **Booked**, **Arrived** and **Late**
A **Closed for bookings tonight** banner when the shop takes no bookings that night

pickNight.title: How to see another night and switch views
steps: Press the left or right arrow to move one night, or press the date to pick from a calendar
Press **Floor plan** to see free and booked tables
Press **List** to see bookings by time, with booking numbers and where they came from

newBooking.title: How to book for a customer
steps: Press **New booking**
Fill in **Customer name** and **Phone**
Choose the **Night** and **Arrival time**, then enter **People**
Choose a **Zone** and **Table** if you know them, or leave them as **Any**
Add a **Note** if needed and press **Save booking** — you'll see the booking number

confirm.title: How to confirm a LINE booking
steps: Look at **Waiting for confirmation** at the top of the page
Press **Confirm + assign** at the end of the booking
Pick a free **Table** and press **Confirm + assign**
The customer gets a confirmation on LINE and sees a QR on their booking page

reject.title: How to reject a booking
steps: Under **Waiting for confirmation** or in the **List** tab, press **Reject** at the end of the booking
Write the **Reason for rejecting**
Press **Reject** — the customer is told on LINE

sheet.title: How to open a booking and check the guest in
steps: On the floor plan, press a table showing a guest's name; in the **List** tab, press a booking row
You'll see the booking number, name, phone, **Time**, **Party**, **Table** and a gold box saying whether the guest has bottles deposited
When the guest arrives, press **Customer arrived** — it turns into **Checked in**
Press **Close** to go back

changeTable.title: How to assign or change a table
steps: Open the booking from the floor plan or the **List** tab
Next to **Table**, press **Change table**
Pick a table from the list — it saves at once and shows **Table assigned**

cancel.title: How to cancel a confirmed booking
steps: Open the booking from the floor plan or the **List** tab
Press **Cancel booking**
Add a **Reason for cancelling** if there is one, then press **Cancel booking** again to confirm
The status becomes **Cancelled**, the table is free at once and the customer is told on LINE

important: **Customer arrived** only works for tonight's bookings
Bookings made by staff are confirmed at once, without waiting for the bar — but not on a night the shop is closed for bookings
Guests who don't come within the shop's time turn **No-show**; if they arrive later you can still press **Customer arrived**
**Cancel booking** is for confirmed bookings — while a booking is still waiting, use **Reject**
tips: **Waiting for confirmation** lists every night with bookings waiting — no need to step through the nights
If the guest already picked their table in LINE, leave the table as **Any** when confirming — their table stays
No floor plan yet? The owner adds zones and tables on **Floor plan** in settings

scan.title: Scan QR
scan.intro: Scan a customer's booking QR or the QR on a bottle label, or type a booking number, table or deposit code, to open it right away.
onPage: The camera frame with a **Start camera** button
A **Booking no., table or deposit code** box and a **Find** button
Booking result: name, time, party, table, the guest's deposited bottles and a **Customer arrived** button
Deposit result: liquor, what's left, expiry, and **Open deposit** and **Withdraw** buttons

scanBooking.title: How to check in with a booking QR
steps: Press the round scan button in the middle of the bottom bar, or **Scan QR** in the left menu
Press **Start camera** and allow camera access
Point the camera at the QR on the booking page on the guest's phone
Check the name, time and party, then press **Customer arrived**
Press **Close** to scan the next guest

typeCode.title: How to find something by typing
steps: Type a booking number such as BK-0924-003, a table such as A3, or a deposit code such as DEP-SRC-7K2QX
Press **Find**
Typing a table name opens that table's booking for tonight

scanDeposit.title: How to withdraw from a bottle label
steps: Scan the QR on the bottle label, or type the deposit code
Check the customer name, liquor and what's left
Press **Withdraw** to create a withdrawal request, or **Open deposit** to see everything

important: If the camera won't open, allow camera access in the browser, or type instead
You can only find items from the selected branch
tips: The booking QR appears on the guest's page once the shop confirms; if they have no QR yet, type the booking number
Guest can't remember the booking number? Typing the table they were given works too

overview.title: All branches
overview.intro: The owner's home page: what needs attention, how tonight is going, and the business numbers of every branch on one page.
onPage: Period buttons **This month**, **Last month**, **Last 30 days**
**Needs attention**: chips for waiting work across all branches, such as **Bottles to confirm**, **Withdrawal requests**, **Bookings to confirm**, **Awaiting disposal**, **Printer offline**
Five figures **Bottles in store**, **New deposits**, **Withdrawn**, **Disposed**, **Show-up rate**, each compared with the previous period and with an 8-week trend line
**Tonight**, updated live: bookings by hour, arrived, expected, to confirm and no-shows
**Expiring soon**, **Recent disposals** and **Latest activity**
**By branch**: each branch's printer, LINE and staff-group status, plus tonight's work
**Busiest nights**, **Top customers** and **Most deposited**

actions.title: How to clear work from Needs attention
steps: Look at the chips in **Needs attention** — each number is the total across branches
Press a chip to open the page where that work is done
With nothing waiting it shows **Nothing waiting**

period.title: How to change the period of the figures
steps: Press **This month**, **Last month** or **Last 30 days** at the top right
The figures follow the chosen period and compare it with the one before
Press a figure to continue in **Reports** for that period (**Bottles in store** opens **Deposits**)

drill.title: How to look into a branch
steps: Press an item in **Expiring soon**, **Recent disposals**, **Latest activity**, or a badge on a branch card
The app switches to that branch and opens the right page for you
Press **Open tonight's floor plan** to open **Bookings**

important: After you open an item from another branch, your selected branch changes too — check the branch name before carrying on
tips: The green **Live** dot on **Tonight** means those numbers update by themselves
The **LINE not delivered** chip takes you to **Branch LINE** to check the setup
The **Printer offline** chip takes you to the printer part of **Branch details**

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Deposits and bookings for all branches or one branch over the period you choose, with Excel and PDF export.
onPage: Quick ranges **This month**, **Last month**, **30 days**, **90 days**
**From**, **To** and **Branch** fields and a **Show report** button
**Liquor deposits** and **Table bookings** figures compared with the previous period
Charts **Deposited · withdrawn (bottles)** and **Bookings per night**
**Busiest weekdays**, **Most deposited** and **Top customers**
**Staff** and **Disposed in this period**
The **By branch** table and the **Export** button

range.title: How to pick the period and branch
steps: Press a quick range such as **This month** or **90 days**
Or pick the **From** and **To** dates yourself
Set **Branch** to **All branches** or one branch
Press **Show report**

export.title: How to export Excel or PDF
steps: Set the period and branch first
Press **Export** at the top right
Choose **Export Excel** or **PDF report** — the file downloads to your device

important: The period can be one year at most, and **From** can't be after **To**
Exported files use the period and branch currently chosen on the page
tips: Every figure is compared with the previous period — the change shows as a percentage next to it
For ranges longer than two months, the charts show weeks instead of days
**Staff** shows how many deposits each person received, confirmed, handed over and checked in

branchSettings.title: Branch details
branchSettings.intro: The basics of the selected branch: opening hours, deposit term, no-withdrawal days, receipt header and footer, and the printer.
onPage: The **Finish setting up the shop** card with progress and the **Next step**
**Branch name**, the **Branch active** switch, **Opens at** and **Closes at**
**Deposit term (days)** and **Expiry reminder (days before)**
**No in-store withdrawals on**, with days to tap
**Deposit receipt**: **Receipt header**, **Receipt footer** and **Copies**
**Printer** and **Printer status**, with the latest print jobs

setup.title: How to use the setup card
steps: Read the **Next step** on the card and press **Set up**
Press **All steps (7)** to see which steps are done

The seven steps are **Connect the LINE OA**, **Set up the customer LIFF app**, **Bind the staff LINE group**, **Install the printer**, **Lay out the tables**, **Add liquor items** and **Create staff accounts**
When every step is done it shows **Setup complete**

edit.title: How to edit the branch
steps: Change the fields you need, such as **Deposit term (days)** or **Expiry reminder (days before)**
Under **No in-store withdrawals on**, tap days to turn them on or off
Change **Receipt header**, **Receipt footer** and **Copies** if you like
Press **Save**

printer.title: How to set up printing
steps: Turn on **Show the LINE QR on the receipt** so receipts carry the shop's LINE QR and a 6-character code for linking LINE (set up the branch LINE first)
If you want, turn on **Limit printer working hours** and set **Start** and **End**
Enter the **Printer name** as it is named on the shop computer, e.g. POS80
Press **Save**

install.title: How to install the printer at the shop
steps: Open this page on the Windows computer connected to the shop's receipt printer
Press **Set up printer**, then **Confirm** — a zip file downloads
Unzip it, right-click INSTALL.bat and choose Run as administrator
Wait for it to finish — the dot on the printer icon turns green, **Online**

retry.title: How to reprint a failed job
steps: Look at the jobs under **Printer status**
For a job showing **Failed**, press **Print again**
Press **Try again** to reload the latest status

important: This page edits only the selected branch — switch branch before editing another
Changing **Deposit term (days)** only affects new deposits
Pressing **Set up printer** again makes the old file stop working at once — install the new file on the shop computer
tips: On no-in-store-withdrawal days, customers can still take bottles home
Keep the printer window on the shop computer open; if it gets closed, double-click START-PrintServer.bat in C:\print-server
Turning off **Branch active** removes the branch from the branch picker — turn it back on under **Users & branches**, tab **Branches**

bookingSettings.title: Booking rules
bookingSettings.intro: The booking rules of the selected branch and the calendar of closed dates. Everything applies to new bookings only.
onPage: Switches **Take bookings on LINE** and **Confirm bookings automatically**
**Table choice**: **The shop seats guests** or **Guests pick their table**
**Open for booking (days ahead)**, **Close same-night bookings at**, **First slot**, **Last slot** and **Every (min)**
**No-show after (min)**, **Max bookings per night (tables)** and **Customer can cancel on LINE up to (hours before)**
**Min party**, **Max party** and **Weekly closed days**
The **Closed dates** calendar with a **Reason (shown to customers)** field

rules.title: How to set the booking rules
steps: Turn on **Take bookings on LINE** to let customers book themselves; with it off, staff can still take bookings
Turn on **Confirm bookings automatically** if customers should get their QR at once; leave it off if the shop confirms each one
Set the bookable times with **First slot**, **Last slot** and **Every (min)**
Fill in the other numbers the shop wants; leave **Max bookings per night (tables)** blank for no limit
Press **Save**

tableChoice.title: How to choose who picks the table
steps: Under **Table choice**, pick **The shop seats guests** if guests only say which zone they'd like and staff pick the table when confirming
Or pick **Guests pick their table** if guests should see the floor plan in LINE and pick a free table
Press **Save**
With **Guests pick their table**, go on to **Floor plan** to set which tables guests can book and on which nights

weekly.title: How to set weekly closed days
steps: Under **Weekly closed days**, tap the days the shop takes no bookings — struck-through days are closed
Tap a day again to open it
Press **Save**

blackout.title: How to close single dates in the calendar
steps: Type the **Reason (shown to customers)** first, e.g. closed for a public holiday
Use the arrows to find the month, then tap the date to close
The date turns red and a message confirms it's closed
Tap the same date again to reopen it

important: All rules apply to new bookings only — bookings already taken don't change
Calendar dates save the moment you tap them; the rules and **Table choice** need **Save** every time
On a closed night, neither customers nor staff can book
tips: Weekly closed days and past dates can't be tapped in the calendar
**Open for booking (days ahead)**, **Close same-night bookings at** and **Max bookings per night (tables)** apply to LINE bookings; staff can still book outside them
Dates marked **Fully booked** in the calendar have reached the nightly maximum

floorPlan.title: Floor plan
floorPlan.intro: Set up the zones and tables of the selected branch. The plan is used on Bookings and decides which zones or tables customers can book on LINE.
onPage: **Add zone** and **Add table** buttons
A card for each zone with **Edit** and **Delete**
In each zone: **Table**, **Shape**, **Seats**, a **Bookable** / **Not bookable** / **Zone closed** / **Closed N nights** badge, the **Active** switch and **Edit**
At the foot of each zone card: the **Customers can book on LINE** and **Active** switches for the whole zone
A note at the bottom saying whether the shop seats guests or guests pick their table

addZone.title: How to add a zone
steps: Press **Add zone**
Enter the **Zone name** and **Order**
Turn on **Customers can book on LINE** if customers may book this zone themselves
Press **Save**

addTable.title: How to add a table
steps: Press **Add table** (you need a zone first)
Enter the **Table name**, then choose the **Zone** and **Shape**
Enter **Min seats** and **Max seats**
Enter the **Order** and press **Save**

tableBooking.title: How to set whether guests can pick this table
steps: Press **Edit** on the table
Turn **Guests can book** on or off — off means guests can never pick this table themselves
To close it only on some nights, under **Closed on some nights** pick a date and press **Add night**
To open that night again, press the ✕ next to the date
Press **Save** to keep any other changes in the window

zoneSwitch.title: How to open or close a zone for customers
steps: At the foot of the zone card, tap the **Customers can book on LINE** switch
When it's off, customers can't choose this zone in LINE and its tables show **Zone closed**

retire.title: How to stop using a table or zone
steps: Turn off a table's **Active** switch — it disappears from the plan and the booking forms
Turn off the **Active** switch at the foot of a zone card to stop using the whole zone
To delete a zone, press **Delete** once it has no tables left

important: This page edits only the selected branch, and table names must be unique within a branch
**Guests can book** and **Closed on some nights** apply to guests picking tables in LINE; staff can still seat guests at that table
Nights under **Closed on some nights** save the moment you press **Add night** or ✕
tips: Set **Min seats** and **Max seats** to match the real table — when guests pick tables, a party that doesn't fit can't pick it
Use **Order** to line tables up like the room; the plan on **Bookings** follows it
To move a table to another zone, press **Edit** and change **Zone**

liquorList.title: Liquor list
liquorList.intro: The liquor names staff pick from when taking a deposit — for every branch or only some.
onPage: The **Add item** button
Items with **Name**, **Category** and **Branch**
An **Active** switch and an **Edit** button on each item

add.title: How to add a liquor
steps: Press **Add item**
Enter the **Name**, then choose a **Category** such as **Whisky**, **Brandy** or **Wine**
Under **Branch**, choose **All branches** or one branch
Enter the **Order** and press **Save**

edit.title: How to edit or hide an item
steps: Press **Edit** on the item, change it and press **Save**
For a liquor you no longer accept, turn off **Active** — staff won't see it any more

important: This list is shared by every branch — set each item's branch under **Branch**
tips: Give the most-deposited liquors a low **Order** so they come first on the deposit form
Staff can still type a liquor that isn't on the list
After you turn off **Active**, old deposits still show their liquor name

users.title: Users & branches
users.intro: Create staff accounts, set roles and branch access, set new passwords, and add or edit branches.
onPage: Tabs **Users** and **Branches**
**Users** tab: an **Add user** button and a list with **Username**, **Display name**, **Role**, **Branch access** and **Active** or **Disabled**
**Edit** and **Set new password** buttons for each person
**Branches** tab: an **Add branch** button and a table of **Branch code**, **Branch name**, **Deposit term (days)** and **Branch active**

addUser.title: How to add a user
steps: Press **Add user**
Enter the **Username** they'll log in with (a–z 0–9 . _ -) and a **Display name**
Choose the **Role**: staff, bar or owner
Tick their **Branch access**
Enter an **Initial password** of at least 8 characters and press **Save**
Give the username and password to the staff member

editUser.title: How to change a role or branches, or disable an account
steps: Press **Edit** on the person
Change the **Display name** or **Role**, or tick **Branch access**
When someone leaves, turn off **Active**
Press **Save**

resetPassword.title: How to set a new password for someone
steps: Press **Set new password** on the person
Enter a new password of at least 8 characters and press **Save**
Ask them to change it to their own on **My account**

addBranch.title: How to add a branch
steps: Open the **Branches** tab and press **Add branch**
Enter a **Branch code** of 2–5 English letters and the **Branch name**
Press **Save**
Press **Edit** on the new branch to set opening hours, deposit term and no-withdrawal days

important: The branch code appears in every deposit code of that branch, e.g. DEP-SRC-XXXXX — choose it carefully from the start
Your own role and active status have to be changed by another owner
tips: The owner always sees every branch — no need to tick branches
Each branch should have at least one staff or bar account
When someone leaves, turn off **Active**; their work history stays complete in the reports

branchLine.title: Branch LINE
branchLine.intro: Connect the selected branch's LINE OA so the shop can message customers, open its pages inside LINE and send alerts to the staff group.
onPage: **LINE OA channel**: **LIFF ID**, **Channel ID** and **Bot user ID**
**Messaging API secrets**: **Channel access token** and **Channel secret**, marked **Set (hidden)** or **Not set**
**Webhook URL** and **LIFF endpoint URL** with copy buttons
The **Branch LIFF link**
**Staff LINE group**: **Group linked** or **No group linked**, with **Make a group code** and **Send a test message to the group**

connect.title: How to connect the LINE OA
steps: Open this branch's LINE Developers console in another window
Copy the **LIFF ID**, **Channel ID** and **Bot user ID** in — each field shows an example of the format
Paste the **Channel access token** and **Channel secret**
Press **Save** — they change to **Set (hidden)**

urls.title: How to set up the webhook and the customer pages
steps: Press the copy button next to **Webhook URL**, paste it into LINE Developers › Messaging API › Webhook URL, then turn on Use webhook
Press the copy button next to **LIFF endpoint URL** and paste it into LINE Developers › LINE Login › LIFF › Endpoint URL
Use the **Branch LIFF link** as the link of the buttons in the shop's LINE chat menu

group.title: How to bind the staff LINE group
steps: Invite the branch's LINE OA bot into the staff LINE group
In the app, press **Make a group code** — you get a code starting with SIS-
Type the code in the group before the time shown under it
The bot replies **Staff group connected** in the group; refresh this page to see **Group linked**
Press **Send a test message to the group** to check that messages arrive

important: Leaving **Channel access token** or **Channel secret** blank keeps the current value; saved values are never shown again
The **LIFF endpoint URL** must be the link this page gives — if it points at the site's home page, customers land on the staff login instead
Each branch has its own LINE OA; this page sets up only the selected branch
tips: The staff group gets alerts for deposit requests, withdrawal requests and new bookings waiting for confirmation
With the **Bot user ID** filled in, you can turn on **Show the LINE QR on the receipt** in **Branch details**
To move the alerts to a new group, repeat the binding steps in that group

cxStart.title: Opening the shop in LINE
cxStart.intro: Customers use the branch's LINE account — no sign-up, no password. This part helps staff guide them.
onPage: A 3-slot bottom bar: **My bottles** · **Book a table** · **My bookings**
The top of the page shows the page name and the branch name
Top left: a back button on the **Deposit a bottle** and **Your booking** pages
Top right: a language button and a theme button
Opened outside the LINE app, it shows **Open this page in LINE**

open.title: How to open the shop in LINE
steps: The customer adds the branch's LINE as a friend, e.g. by scanning the QR on the receipt
They press a button in the chat's menu, or type “menu” and press a button on the reply card
The shop pages open in LINE with the **My bottles**, **Book a table** and **My bookings** tabs

link.title: How a customer sees their deposit in LINE
steps: Give the customer the receipt
The customer scans the QR on it to add the branch's LINE
The customer types the 6-character code from the receipt in the chat
LINE replies **LINE linked** — the deposit shows under **My bottles** and the customer gets a reminder before it expires

important: The receipt carries the shop's LINE QR and the 6-character code when the owner turns on **Show the LINE QR on the receipt**
The DEP code on the bottle label can't link LINE — only the 6-character code on the receipt can
Each branch has its own LINE; the customer must add the LINE of the branch holding their bottle
tips: Customers who send a deposit request in LINE don't need a code — the deposit is linked to their LINE already
The deposit page shows whether the customer is **LINE linked** or **LINE not linked**
Customer lost the receipt? Print a new one with **Print receipt**

cxBottles.title: My bottles
cxBottles.intro: The customer's first page in LINE: stored bottles, how much is left, the collect-by date, and requesting a bottle themselves.
onPage: Tabs **Stored N** and **History**
A card per deposit: liquor, deposit code, a level bar and the **Collect by** date
A **VIP** or **N days left** badge when expiry is near
A **Request my bottle** button on stored deposits
A **Deposit another bottle** button at the end — with nothing stored yet, a dashed **Deposit a bottle** frame instead

withdraw.title: How a customer requests a bottle
steps: Press **Request my bottle** on the card
Tick the bottles under **Choose bottles**
Under **For**, choose **Drinking here** or **Taking home**
Enter **Your table**, e.g. A3, and press **Send request**
The card now says **Staff are bringing your bottle**, and the request lands in the shop's **Withdrawals** tab

status.title: How to read the card messages
steps: **Request sent — hand the bottle to staff**: the customer filled in a deposit request and should hand the bottle over
**Waiting for the bar to confirm**: staff received the bottle; the bar still has to confirm
**Staff are bringing your bottle**: a withdrawal request was sent
The **History** tab: deposits fully withdrawn, expired, disposed or cancelled

important: On a no-in-store-withdrawal day, customers can only choose **Taking home**
When the bar completes the withdrawal, the customer gets **Bottles collected** on LINE; if it's rejected, **Request declined**
tips: Customer can't see their bottle? Have them type the 6-character code from the receipt in the branch's LINE chat
Bottles are withdrawn whole; several can be picked at once

cxDeposit.title: Deposit a bottle
cxDeposit.path: LINE › My bottles › Deposit a bottle
cxDeposit.intro: Customers fill in a deposit request in LINE before handing the bottle over — the deposit goes faster and is linked to their LINE at once.
onPage: Fields **Name**, **Phone**, **Liquor**, **Bottles** (− +), **Table** and **Notes**
The 6-point **Bottle Storage and Collection Terms** box with a tick box to accept
The **Send deposit request** button

request.title: How a customer sends a deposit request
steps: In **My bottles**, press **Deposit another bottle** (or the **Deposit a bottle** frame when nothing is stored yet) — or type “deposit” in the chat and press **Deposit**
Fill in **Name**, **Liquor** and **Bottles**; add **Phone** and **Table** if they like
Read the **Bottle Storage and Collection Terms** and tick to accept
Press **Send deposit request**, then hand the bottle to staff

staffSide.title: How staff receive the bottle
steps: The request shows in the **LINE requests** tab, on the bell and in the staff LINE group
Open it, press **Receive bottles**, set **Bottles**, take a photo and press **Receive bottles**
The bar confirms as usual, and the customer gets **Deposit stored** on LINE

important: The terms must be ticked before the request can be sent
A request isn't a deposit yet — staff must press **Receive bottles** when the bottle is handed over
tips: Help customers with the terms: the deposit term, the no-withdrawal days, and collection until 4:00 a.m. on the day after the expiry date
If the bar rejects it, the customer gets **Deposit declined** with the reason

cxBook.title: Book a table
cxBook.intro: Customers pick the date, time, party size and a zone or table, and send a booking request themselves in LINE.
onPage: A row of dates for the next 14 days; closed dates can't be tapped
**Arrival time** as slot buttons
**People** with − + buttons
**Preferred zone** or **Any**, when the shop seats guests
**Pick a table** as a floor plan, when guests pick their own table
**Name**, **Phone**, **Note to the shop** and the **Send booking request** button

book.title: How a customer books a table
steps: Press **Book a table** in the bottom bar
Tap a date, then an **Arrival time**
Press − or + to set **People**
Choose a **Preferred zone** or **Any**
Fill in **Name**, and **Phone** and **Note to the shop** if needed
Press **Send booking request** — the **Your booking** page opens

pickTable.title: How a customer picks their own table (when the shop allows it)
steps: After the date, time and party size, **Pick a table** appears instead of zones
Tap a table marked **Free** — it becomes **Your pick**
**Taken** and **Not bookable** tables can't be tapped; tables too small or too big for the party are dimmed
Fill in the name and press **Send booking request**

important: Without automatic confirmation, the booking waits for the shop; the customer is told on LINE when it's confirmed
If it says the table was just taken, pick another table and send again
If it says there's no free table for that party, try another date or party size
tips: Customers with bottles at the branch see a note to tell staff when they arrive
If the branch isn't taking LINE bookings, customers see a message to call the shop — staff can use **New booking** instead

cxBookings.title: My bookings
cxBookings.intro: The customer's bookings. Open one to see the booking number and the QR to show at the door, and to cancel it themselves.
onPage: The **My bookings** page: upcoming bookings first, past ones under **History**
Each card shows its status — **Waiting for the shop**, **Confirmed**, **Checked in** or **Cancelled** — with the date, time, party and the table once assigned
The **Your booking** page: the **Booking no.** and the QR
**Date**, **Time** (with the arrive-by time), **Party**, **Name**, and **Table** once assigned
A status line under the booking, such as confirmed or waiting for the shop
The **Cancel booking** button

showQr.title: How to show a booking at the door
steps: The customer presses **My bookings** in the bottom bar, then the booking for that night
They show the QR for staff to scan on **Scan QR**
No QR yet? Staff can type the **Booking no.** instead

cancel.title: How a customer cancels a booking
steps: Open **Your booking** and press **Cancel booking**
Press **Cancel booking** again to confirm, or **Close** to keep it
The customer gets **Booking cancelled** on LINE

important: The QR appears once the shop confirms; until then the page says the QR will appear after confirmation
Customers can cancel themselves up to the number of hours before the booking that the shop set; after that the button is disabled and they contact the shop directly
tips: On the booking day, the customer gets a **Your booking today** reminder on LINE
The arrive-by time is when the booking turns **No-show**

cxLanguage.title: Language and theme
cxLanguage.intro: Customers choose the language and the colour mode of the shop pages in LINE themselves.
onPage: The language button (a letters icon) opens **ไทย** · **English** · **中文** · **한국어**
The chosen language has a tick next to it
The theme button (a sun or moon icon) switches between the night look and the light look

language.title: How a customer changes the language
steps: Press the language button at the top right
Choose **ไทย**, **English**, **中文** or **한국어**
The shop pages and the LINE messages the customer gets from then on use that language

theme.title: How a customer changes the theme
steps: Press the sun button for the light look
Press the moon button to go back to the night look

important: The chosen language also applies to the LINE messages the shop sends the customer
tips: The first time, the pages follow the language of the customer's LINE app
For foreign customers, switch the language before a deposit request so they read the terms in a language they understand
The theme is remembered on the customer's phone

cxChat.title: Chat words in LINE
cxChat.intro: Customers type a short word in the branch's LINE chat and get a card with buttons to the page they need.
onPage: “deposit” → a card with a **Deposit** button
“withdraw” → a **Choose bottles to withdraw** button
“my bottles” → a **View my bottles** button
“book” → a **Book a table** button
“my bookings” → a **View my bookings** button
“menu” or “help” → every button on one card
The 6-character code from the receipt → links that deposit to LINE

keyword.title: How to use chat words
steps: Open the branch's LINE chat
Type the word on its own, e.g. “book” (Thai polite endings such as ครับ or ค่ะ are fine)
Press the button on the reply card — the shop page opens in LINE

important: A long sentence gets no reply card — type just the short word

Customers also get messages from the shop by themselves, such as **Deposit stored**, **Expiring soon**, **Expired**, **Disposed of**, **Bottles collected**, **Booking confirmed** and **Your booking today**
tips: Thai, Chinese and Korean words work too, e.g. ฝาก, เบิก, จองโต๊ะ, เมนู
After several wrong codes, the customer has to wait 15 minutes before trying again
If a customer types the DEP code from a bottle label, LINE replies asking for the 6-character code on the receipt

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.intro: See who did what, and when, across every branch — deposits, withdrawals, bookings, printing, settings and user management
onPage: Kind-of-work buttons **All**, **Deposits**, **Withdrawals**, **Bookings**, **Printing**, **Settings** and **Users & access**, each with its count
Period buttons **Today**, **7 days**, **30 days** and the **From** and **To** dates
The **Branch** and **Done by** filters and a **Search** box for a code, table or customer name
The entries by day — each says what was done, the code or name it concerns, the time, who did it with their role, and the branch
A **Details** button under an edit shows the old and new value of every field that changed

byKind.title: How to see one kind of work
steps: Press a kind-of-work button such as **Bookings**
Only that kind is listed; press **All** to see everything again

trace.title: How to find who did what to one booking or deposit
steps: Pick the period with **Today**, **7 days** or **30 days**, or set **From** and **To**
Pick a **Branch** and **Done by** if you want
Type the booking number, deposit code, table or customer name in **Search** and press **Show**

details.title: How to see what an edit changed
steps: Find an edit such as **Table edited** or **Booking settings changed**
Press **Details** to see every field that changed — the old value struck through, the new one in bold

important: Entries in the log cannot be edited or deleted, so it stands as a record of what happened
tips: What a customer did in LINE shows **Customer (LINE)** as who; what happens on its own in time — a deposit expiring, a no-show — shows **Automatic**
For a long list, use **Next** and **Previous** at the bottom to change page
